title: Kissed Flaky Croatian Meat Pastry
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring flaky pastry and savory meat filling, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe uses dark brown soft sugar and can be adapted to be sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Stir in the dark brown soft sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Spoon the meat mixture onto one half of the pastry dough, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry dough with the beaten egg.
Fold the other half of the pastry dough over the meat mixture and press the edges to seal.
Place the pastry in a copper mug and bake for 25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the pastry from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
